name: Springloaded Statues

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-20: The Rakshasa's Court

disable: DC 28 Thievery check (expert) or DC 31 Stealth check (expert) to disarm the statue while adjacent to it
reset: Each statue resets immediately after being triggered.

items.name: Iced
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on one of the plain silver tiles in the statuary

---
Effect A wave of cold passes through the target, dealing 2d10+13 cold damage (DC 26 basic Fortitude save save).

items.name: Slithering Shock
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on one of the diamond-embedded silver tiles in the statuary

---
Effect A jolt of electricity arcs up from the tile and strikes the target, dealing 2d10+13 electricity damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save save).

items.name: Yowl
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps on one of the plain copper tiles in the statuary

---
Effect The high-pitched yowl of an attacking cat echoes in the target's head, dealing 2d10+13 sonic damage (DC 26 basic Fortitude save save).

text: Four animal statues sit on pillars, one in each corner of the statuary, with decorated tiles between them in a seemingly random arrangement.
